name: Ace SVC
summary: A Simple Voice Chat port for Pumpkin. Not planned: the author doesn't allow ports of his code. Use Ace Plasmo for voice.
description:
## Not planned

We asked Max Henkel, the author of **Simple Voice Chat**, whether we could translate its server side into a Pumpkin plugin. His answer was no: no copying of the mod's code, translations included. We respect that, so nothing from Simple Voice Chat will be ported.

## Voice chat on Pumpkin today

[Ace Plasmo](/plugin/ace-plasmo) gives Pumpkin servers proximity voice chat with the **Plasmo Voice** client mod (LGPL-3.0), and it's out now.

## What could still happen

The author said a **clean-room implementation** is fine: our own server, written only from observed behaviour (network traffic between the real mod and a server, and public documentation), never from his source. That would be an independent project that works with the Simple Voice Chat mod, not a port. It isn't started.
